title: Google Ads for Dentists: The Complete 2026 Guide | Jarrett Digital

facts.fact: The vendor, Jarrett Digital, says its guide is based on its experience managing dental campaigns since 2007.
facts.quote: based on experience managing dental campaigns since 2007

facts.fact: The vendor reports that for one cosmetic dentistry client, its campaign reliably generated 35-40 high-quality leads every day.
facts.quote: we were able to start reliably generating **35-40 high-quality leads every single day**

facts.fact: The vendor states that cost per click for dental keywords typically ranges from $3 to $20, depending on procedure and location.
facts.quote: Cost per click for dental keywords typically ranges from $3 to $20, depending on procedure and location.

facts.fact: The vendor says that as of 2026, most dental practices it works with generate leads at $15-$60 each, depending on treatment type.
facts.quote: As of 2026, most dental practices we work with generate leads at $15-$60 each, depending on the treatment type.

facts.fact: The vendor states that dental implant keywords are the most expensive dental keywords it sees.
facts.quote: Dental implant keywords are the most expensive.

facts.fact: The vendor says most dental campaigns start generating enquiries within 2-3 weeks of launch.
facts.quote: Most dental campaigns start generating enquiries within 2-3 weeks.

facts.fact: The vendor describes the first 60-90 days of a dental Google Ads campaign as an optimisation period.
facts.quote: The first 60-90 days are an optimisation period.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends starting dental Google Ads with Search campaigns and adding remarketing (Display) only after there is enough traffic data.
facts.quote: We typically recommend starting with Search, then layering in remarketing once you have enough traffic data.

facts.fact: The page names Google Keyword Planner, SpyFu, and Semrush as keyword research tools for dental campaigns.
facts.quote: Use tools like Google Keyword Planner, SpyFu, or Semrush.
